portInfo.description: bremenports’ cruise-shipping competence page centres on Bremerhaven’s Columbus Quay facilities (up to four liners; check-in areas for around 4,000 passengers). This guide for Bremen city therefore does not invent a city ocean terminal. Confirm whether your itinerary is Bremen city or Bremerhaven before planning.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Marktplatz / Town Musicians — ~60 min (only if in Bremen).
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ticket naming “Bremen” often means Bremerhaven for ocean ships — verify.
